chunks.text_original: Wer ein Tier hält, muss es angemessen nähren, pflegen und ihm die für sein Wohlergehen notwendige Beschäftigung gewähren.
chunks.text_en: Anyone who keeps an animal must feed and care for it appropriately and provide the activity necessary for its well-being. Dog owners must ensure the dog does not endanger people or other animals.

documents.title_en: Federal Act on Footpaths and Hiking Trails

chunks.text_original: Dieses Gesetz regelt die Planung, Anlage und Erhaltung von Fuss- und Wanderwegnetzen.
chunks.text_en: This Act governs the planning, construction and maintenance of footpath and hiking trail networks. Cantons are responsible for hiking trail networks and their signposting.

documents.title_en: Dogs in the Canton of Zurich

chunks.text_original: Im Kanton Zürich gilt vom 1. April bis 31. Juli im Wald und am Waldrand Leinenpflicht für Hunde.
chunks.text_en: In the Canton of Zurich, dogs must be kept on a leash in forests and at forest edges from 1 April to 31 July to protect wildlife. This applies on hiking trails through forest.

chunks.text_original: In den Parkanlagen der Stadt Zürich sind Hunde an der Leine zu führen. Ausgenommen sind markierte Hundefreilaufzonen.
chunks.text_en: In the parks of the City of Zurich dogs must be kept on a leash, except in marked off-leash dog zones. A list of off-leash zones is published by Grün Stadt Zürich.

chunks.text_original: Im Kreis 3 befindet sich eine Hundefreilaufzone im Fritschiwiese-Park in Wiedikon.
chunks.text_en: In Kreis 3 there is an off-leash dog zone at Fritschiwiese park in Wiedikon. Dogs may run free there; on the Uetliberg hiking trails they must be leashed in the forest season.

chunks.text_original: Auf Alpweiden mit Mutterkühen Hunde an die Leine nehmen und Abstand halten.
chunks.text_en: On alpine pastures with suckler cows keep your dog on a leash and keep your distance. Leash rules on hiking trails differ by canton; check the cantonal rules before you go.

chunks.text_original: Dog tax is levied by the cantons and communes; the amount varies by commune.
chunks.text_en: Dog tax is levied by the cantons and communes; the amount varies by commune. Ask your commune for the rate and registration procedure.

chunks.text_original: In Basel-Stadt gilt in allen öffentlichen Parks ganzjährig Leinenpflicht für Hunde.
chunks.text_en: In Basel-Stadt dogs must be leashed in all public parks all year round. There are no seasonal exceptions on hiking trails in the canton.
